note: Every error is {error}. Send the customer's access token (the one the identity service issued) as 'Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>'; the chatbot passes it on to the platform services, so the customer only ever sees their own cart and orders. 401 = no token, an unreadable one, or one the platform rejected. Conversations are kept in memory per customer and sessionId and are forgotten after an hour idle or on restart.

body.sessionId: string (max 100; any id the app picks for one conversation, for example a UUID)
